info.title: Qontent Tube automation
info.summary: Plan, run, review, and collect product-demo productions on the computer that runs Qontent Tube.
info.description:
Served only by the local automation listener (`qontent-tube automation serve`), bound to 127.0.0.1 on an explicit port. Never by Cloudflare, never by the browser UI.

Authenticate with exactly one credential: a scoped bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer …`) or a scoped API key in the `x-qt-api-key` header. Never in a URL. A request with both is refused.

Nothing here approves a review for a person: gates the bundle does not mark `unattended: policy`, and every privacy review, are answered in Studio or with `qontent-tube demo decide`.

get.summary: What this runtime can do, and what this credential may do
get.description:
Product version, local runner readiness and tool versions, the credential’s scopes and resources, and the projects it may use with their demo bundle identity. Never a path or a secret.

Requires the `capabilities:read` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `capabilities:read` on this project.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: You need to know whether productions can run here and which projects you may use

get.description:
Every problem with its bundle-relative path and a suggestion, the plan identity, and a summary of sources, takes, effects, secrets (names only), and gates. Changes nothing.

Requires the `bundles:plan` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `bundles:plan` on this project.

404.description: The project has no demo bundle.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: Before planning or running, to check the demo bundle

post.summary: Plan a production without starting it
post.description:
The closed-catalog steps, variants, gates, effects, and which steps would be reused. Changes nothing.

Requires the `bundles:plan` scope.

200.description: The plan, or null with diagnostics.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `bundles:plan` on this project.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: To see the steps, variants, gates, effects, and reuse of a production before starting it

get.summary: List the project’s productions, newest first
get.description:
Each run’s status, bundle identity, and timestamps.

Requires the `runs:read` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `runs:read` on this project.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: To find earlier or running productions of a project

post.summary: Start a production on this computer
post.description:
Runs until it finishes, fails, or waits for a person. Send an Idempotency-Key (one is generated when absent and returned in the response header): repeating the request returns the same run; the same key with a different body is refused. Never approves a gate.

Requires the `runs:start` scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeat a request safely: the same key and body return the original run; the same key with another body is refused (409 idempotency_conflict). Generated when absent and returned in the response header.

200.description: Already started with this Idempotency-Key and body.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `runs:start` on this project.

409.description: Not runnable here, or the key was used for another request.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: The person asked for a production and the plan was reviewed
avoid-when: The plan has not been reviewed, or a production with the same request is already running

x-hapi-prerequisites: Every secret the plan names is configured
Hooks the plan runs are trusted on this computer

get.summary: Read a production: steps, gates, artifacts, and continuation
get.description:
The continuation lists each waiting gate with its question, choices, and the evidence hash a decision must name.

Requires the `runs:read` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `runs:read` on this project.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: To see where a production stands and which gate waits for a person

get.summary: Read or follow a production’s events as NDJSON
get.description:
Stored events after `after` (a sequence number). With `follow=true`, live events follow, each once, with a heartbeat line every 15 seconds, until the run stops moving. Reconnect with the last sequence seen.

Requires the `runs:read` scope.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only events with a greater sequence.

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description: Continue with live events (and heartbeats) until the run stops moving.

200.description: One JSON object per line: a ProductionEvent, or {"type":"heartbeat","at":…} while following.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `runs:read` on this project.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: To follow a production as it runs

post.description:
Running steps finish; nothing new starts until it resumes.

Requires the `runs:control` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `runs:control` on this project.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

post.description:
Owned capture and render work stops at a safe point; committed results stay reusable.

Reruns failed steps (or the named ones); fresh work is kept.

Requires the `runs:control` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `runs:control` on this project.

use-when: A step failed and its cause was fixed
avoid-when: The failure needs a change to the bundle first

post.summary: Answer a gate a credential may answer
post.description:
Only gates the bundle marks `unattended: policy` (never privacy review) may be answered by automation, and only with the evidence hash from the continuation. Every other gate needs a person in Studio or the CLI; the refusal says so.

Requires the `gates:decide` scope.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The gate needs a person (human_only_gate, with its continuation), or the credential lacks gates:decide.

409.description: The evidence changed (stale_gate), or the gate was decided.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: A gate the bundle allows unattended waits, and the person or a trusted policy chose the answer
avoid-when: The gate is a privacy review or needs a person: report it instead

x-hapi-prerequisites: The answer names the evidence hash from the continuation

get.summary: The output manifest and downloadable artifacts of a finished production
get.description:
Portable artifact identities with hashes and sizes, and the operation that downloads each. Refused while the production has not finished.

Requires the `artifacts:read` scope.

200.description: Outputs with hashes and download operations.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `artifacts:read` on this project.

409.description: The production has not succeeded yet (not_finished, with its status).

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: A production succeeded and its videos, captions, and manifest should be reported

get.description:
Render outputs and production files by artifact ID. Send Range to resume a download; the ETag is the SHA-256.

Requires the `artifacts:read` scope.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: One byte range, to resume a download.

200.description: The bytes; ETag is the SHA-256.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired, or revoked credential.

403.description: The credential lacks `artifacts:read` on this project.

416.description: The range is outside the file.

429.description: Too many requests for this credential; see Retry-After.

use-when: To download one output by its artifact ID

x-hapi-prerequisites: The artifact is listed by the outputs operation

bearerAuth.description: A short-lived token from `qontent-tube automation token create` (qtbt_…). Valid until it expires or automation stops.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-qt-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: A named key from `qontent-tube automation key create` (qtak_<id>_<secret>). Persists across restarts until it expires or is revoked.
